context: Hiroshi-boss and Yuki review job candidates.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business HR; vocabulary (依頼/定め/訴え/候補/優れ) in natural home.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 採用の候補は、出揃ったかね?
lines.en: Are the hiring candidates all in?
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい、優れた候補が数名います。
lines.en: Yes, there are several excellent candidates.
lines.style: reliable office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 選ぶ基準は、定めてあるかね?
lines.style: thoughtful boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 事前に、基準を定めました。
lines.en: We set the criteria in advance.
lines.style: clear office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 紹介の依頼も、来ているのかね?
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ええ、依頼をいくつかいただきました。
lines.style: professional office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 自分を、よく訴える人がいいな。
lines.en: Someone who advocates for themselves well is good.
lines.style: firm boss voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 優れた候補を、丁寧に選びます。
lines.en: I'll carefully select the excellent candidates.
lines.style: resolved office woman voice, soft warm clarity closing throughout
